item.title: Tate Aggies Lacrosse Beats Washington 12-7
item.description: Tate High School Girls Lacrosse earned a bit 12-7 win at the Washington Wildcats on Thursday night. The Aggies were coming off losses earlier in the week to West Florida and Gulf Breeze. Next Week, Tate will travel to West Florida on Monday, and Pensacola Catholic on Tuesday.

item.title: Application Deadline Extended For 2026 Summer Youth Employment Program
item.description: Escambia County has extended the application deadline for the 2026 Summer Youth Employment Program, which provides an opportunity for Escambia County youth ages 16-24 to receive paid work experience this summer.
